primary_cohort: Original fold1 FIT only, unique patients; all other outerFIT cohorts are overlapping sensitivity sets, not independent replication
effect: Signed rank-biserial EZ-vs-NEZ of per-channel equal-available-seizure phase means; post-minus-pre is within-channel before between-class ranking. Finite classes required; no missing-value fabricated zero.
interval: 10000 seed42 patient-cluster percentile95% mean-effect intervals; patient is replicate, channels/seizures/windows correlated
test: Two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank, zero_method=wilcox, method=auto; all-zero effects p1; BH across all32x5 primary effects. Source/otherfold descriptive CIs, no independent replication claim.
cross_seizure: For each patient with >=2 finite nonzero per-seizure effects, majority sign fraction; retain zero-run counts separately. Patient aggregate medians and denominators, not individual identities.
operational_reproducibility_rule: Primary BHq<0.05 and CI excludes0; >=60percent patients share mean direction; >=3 source groups with >=5 finite patients each share direction; >=10 repeat-seizure patients and median within-patient sign agreement>=0.7. Failure is insufficient stability evidence, not biological ineffectiveness. This flag never selects features or changes models.
trajectory: Prespecified display of line_length_per_sec,partial_high_gamma_80_125,spectral_entropy_10_125,normalized_line_length,clipped_excess_kurtosis,rebuilt_strength_norm. Full32 supplied. Nonlearned nearest2-second cache-relative display bins from-28to18, tolerance1.01seconds; native actualtime remains authoritative for phase masks. Effects averaged within patient before across-patient intervals.
clinical_limits: EZ/NEZ are stored project annotations, not surgical proof of epileptogenic tissue. Cache-relative pre/post times not independently proven clinical onset; acquisition/filter provenance remains qualified. No source/case exclusion by observed effects.
